create_ocr_mac_model: create an OcrMacModel instance for Mac-only OCR with OcrMacOptions and AcceleratorOptions
run_ocr_mac_model: run the OcrMacModel on a page batch to extract text cells with bounding boxes via native macOS OCR
get_ocr_mac_options_type: get the OcrMacModel options type class returning OcrMacOptions for pipeline configuration
test_ocr_mac_model: test the OcrMacModel on valid pages skipping invalid backends and zero area OCR rectangles
review_ocr_mac_model: review the OcrMacModel coordinate transformation from ocrmac normalized boxes to Docling TOPLEFT bounding boxes
